notes.title: NEW DLC - The Curse of the Golden Crab
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

We have just released a new DLC for Captain Firebeard. 
http://store.steampowered.com/app/831920/The_Curse_of_the_Golden_Crab/

The Curse of the Golden Crab features a new extended story, new characters and the return of some of the old loveable characters. There is also a different challenging mini-game to complete. 

If you enjoyed Captain Firebeard you must get this continuation to the story.

Keep being Awesome!

SDP Team
